_doc: Hand-curated facts the extractor cannot read from a file. Every entry names its source. 'hw' per arch: yes | no | emulate | unknown. 'no' means: never advertise. Overrides the automatic 'hardware possible' column (which is otherwise 'yes' when PanVK or the Arm blob advertises the item on that architecture, else 'unknown').

VK_KHR_acceleration_structure.note: No ray-tracing units in Mali-G610/G615 (Valhall 4th gen). Mali-G925 is listed as 'Mali-G925-Immortalis' in gpuinfo #51936; the blob column shows whether that report advertises it. Compute emulation is possible in principle but no consumer of ours needs it: never advertise on v10/v11.

VK_KHR_video_queue.note: Video decode/encode is a separate VPU block on these SoCs, not the GPU; kbase has no video queue. Never advertise (all VK_KHR_video_*).

geometryShader.note: Valhall has no geometry stage (vk/src/mali_gs.h; PanVK: geometryShader = false, panvk_vX_physical_device.c). Only emulation (vertex/compute lowering) is possible; the pass-through subset exists behind MALI_EXPERIMENTAL_GS=1 and is not advertised. Needs an orchestrator design decision (mali-open skill rule).

tessellationShader.note: No tessellation hardware on Valhall (PanVK: tessellationShader = false). Compute emulation only.

multiViewport.note: Mali tiler takes one viewport/scissor per draw; PanVK multiViewport = false. A per-draw split (one draw per viewport with gl_ViewportIndex lowering) is a driver-side emulation; unverified.

fillModeNonSolid.note: PanVK: false. Point/line polygon mode would need a primitive-conversion pass; see Arm blob column for whether Arm exposes it.

depthBounds.note: PanVK: false. Can be emulated with a fragment discard on the depth read; unverified.

VK_EXT_mesh_shader.note: No mesh/task stage in Valhall 4th gen; emulation via compute + indirect is not worth it for our consumers.

VK_KHR_fragment_shading_rate.note: Variable-rate shading exists on later Mali generations; the Arm blob column is the evidence per GPU.

node_dependent.VK_EXT_physical_device_drm: advertised on x4 and cmf (vulkaninfo.txt of 2026-11-28, smoke x4-1128-031240 / cmf-1128-031509); the fake backend has no DRM node
